notes: 'the sides of the rock' takes its two supplied determiners on the two nouns they stand before, no article morpheme standing in the phrase (rules 15, 29).
בִידֵי is split rather than fused: the ASV spends 'by' on the preposition and 'sides' on the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet (rule 2).
s012 is a stative verb rendered by subject pronoun, copula and adjective; the head is the complement carrying the lexeme (rules 17, 44).
